header.name: PracticeCrystalSimBot BP
header.description: Crystal PvP practice bot as SimulatedPlayer. Requires Beta APIs experiment ON. v0.6.0 (combat rework part 1): bow/crossbow arrows spawn 1.5 blocks ahead of the muzzle (no more zero-range self-hits); elytra dive guarantees at least one mace attack per launch, up to 3 consecutive strikes, mace re-equipped before every strike, and a watchdog force-ends stalled dives (bot can no longer freeze after flying); crystal detonation above the target's head is banned except when surrounded, and feet-level explosions are heavily prioritized (existing-base auto-preference removed). v0.5.6: undefined-entry hardening for SimulatedPlayer in player iteration. v0.5.5: ender_crystal entity id fix for crystal-surf. v0.5.4: hard 0-value cooldowns preserved; hole-escape ladder; blast-mitigation block spam tamed. v0.5.3: namespaced /bot alias. v0.5.2: sourceEntity caller resolution.
